messages.引き裂かれた色彩[ルージュ]・[ブル]と「果敢なタッチ」の3種を敵に切らさず重ね: A Bleed-team amplifier and attacker that maintains both Mauled Color [Rouge] and Mauled Color [Bleu] plus Touche Hardie on enemies, increasing Bleed and Sinking damage by up to 20%. More types of negative effect enhance every skill and turn defense into the powerful Critique.
messages.果敢なタッチ(最大2): 数値1につき、出血・沈潜による体力・精神力の被ダメージ: **Touche Hardie (max 2)**: Per point, +10% HP and SP damage taken from Bleed and Sinking, up to 20%. It decreases by 1 at Turn End. Inflicted by S2 Expression of Primary Colors (target with 5/6 or more negative effect types; the condition differs by Uptie and is relaxed at Uptie Ⅳ), S3, and Critique's third Coin.
messages.S2「原色表現」(エンジン): 1スキルで出血2・沈潜回数+2・[ルージュ]1・: **S2 Expression of Primary Colors (engine)**: One skill inflicts 2 Bleed, +2 Sinking Count, 1 [Rouge], and 2/3 [Bleu], plus 1 Touche Hardie if the condition is met. +20% damage per negative effect type on the target (up to 60%), and +1 Coin Power per 2 types (up to 3; Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.「クリティーク」: 自分にレフレクスィヨンがなく、対象のマイナス効果が3種以上な: **Critique**: If she does not have Réflexion and the target has 3 or more negative effect types, the Defense skill Trimming the Medium transforms (a clashable counter). +2 Clash Power per 2 negative effect types (up to 6), +3 Final Power if Bleed and Sinking total 4 or more, and Coin reuse per 3 types (up to 2 times). After use, she gains 2 Réflexion and cannot use it during that time (restores 5 SP at Turn Start).
messages.野獣派 - マスク・ドゥ・ルー(永続バフ): 強烈な色彩を3付与する、クリティー: **Le Fauvisme - Masque de Loup (permanent buff)**: Gained at Turn End after inflicting 3 Palette Vibrante, using Critique twice, or using the enhanced S3 Burst Forth the Pulsing Crimson under Your Skin. +1 Speed, +1 Bleed and Sinking inflicted, and +1 Sinking Count and Bleed Count on hits against enemies with 3 or more [Bleu] or [Rouge] (once per turn each).
messages.強烈な色彩: 戦闘終了時、3種を全て持つ敵へ次のターンに付与する([ルージュ]・: **Palette Vibrante**: At Combat End, inflicted next turn on enemies that have all 3 types (2/3/4 if [Rouge] and [Bleu] are 3/6/9 or more). Increases damage taken from Ring members (even more from Fauvists). The enhanced S3 activates when the target has 6 or more negative effect types (once per turn; an Unfocused Volley whose fourth Coin hits all targets).
messages.バトルパッシブ「ここはもう少し荒く…！」(色欲×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): [: **Combat passive — Needs a Rougher Touch for this Part...! (2 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +1 to the [Rouge], [Bleu], and Touche Hardie inflicted.
messages.毎ターン色欲×2共鳴でパッシブを発動させながら、S2とS3で3種のマイナス効果を: Keep the passive active with 2 Lust Resonance every turn while maintaining the three negative effects with S2 and S3. On turn 1, when the enemy has no negative effects, the Defense skill Trimming the Medium inflicts more than S1. Once there are 3 or more negative effect types, replace S1 with the Defense skill and fire Critique (it is unavailable during Réflexion, so alternate). On turns when Critique is unavailable, S1 Vehement Overpainting reuses a Coin if the target has 4 or more negative effect types (Uptie Ⅳ). Gaining Masque de Loup through the enhanced S3, two Critiques, or 3 Palette Vibrante makes later Count infliction easier. Negative effects count by number of types, so pairing her with allies who inflict different types speeds up the bonuses (especially strong in Bleed teams against single bosses with a single part).
